name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted And White Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers of acrylic for a dimensional and elegant personalized ornament design.
             +) Layer 1: Frosted Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing.
             +) Layer 2: White Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing.
    - The combination of frosted and white acrylic creates a soft layered effect with added depth and a refined decorative look.
    - Custom-cut construction allows the ornament to be made in unique silhouette shapes to match personalized artwork and themes.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-lasting decorative use.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
             +) 3.54 x 3.54 in ~ 9 x 9 cm
             +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
             +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
             +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Both acrylic layers feature high-quality 1-sided UV printing for clear, vibrant, and detailed personalized artwork.
    - Produced using precision laser cutting to create smooth edges and clean custom silhouette shapes.
    - The Frosted Acrylic layer provides a soft translucent background effect that enhances the printed design.
    - The White Acrylic layer adds a solid decorative front layer for names, messages, frames, and featured design elements.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom hanging ornament for Christmas trees, room décor, holiday decoration, and seasonal display.
    - Suitable for personalization with names, dates, family names, couple themes, festive messages, and holiday artwork.
    - Two-layer construction allows background imagery and front decorative details to be combined into one coordinated ornament design.
    - Lightweight and durable, making it easy to hang and display year after year.
    - Ideal for preserving memorable holiday moments in a personalized keepsake form.
    - Easy to hang with the included hanging accessories.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, first Christmas as a married couple, family keepsakes, newlywed gifts, anniversaries, and holiday celebrations.
    - Great for creating custom ornaments featuring family names, wedding years, meaningful messages, and festive artwork.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake to celebrate love, family, and special holiday moments.
    - A beautiful personalized ornament that combines soft frosted acrylic with clean white acrylic layering for a charming seasonal gift.

  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
